reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492.** Source: "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments at the gate kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the 04:00 shift got through the gate without manual help.
2. **#4419.** Source: "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The note says it was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

What I checked: all six of Moss's notes I can see (four North, two Central), plus the two channels Moss posts in that you're also in. Neither channel had any messages.

Things to know before you paste these in:
- The two numbers look a lot alike (4492 and 4419), but they're for different problems. The cheat sheet has no date, so I can't tell which came first.
- None of these mention a QFL ticket: the 9/14 pipeline digest, the 3/23 renewal check-in or the Central notes. The Central notes do have #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those are for Marrow accounts.
- Marcus's note on Quarendon Freightways (one "r") is about a different company, and it isn't one of Moss's notes anyway.
